title: Home guide: scratch and bend tests
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Properties of materials and habitats (Alchemy Island and Living Things and Their Habitats)
source: Written for science/y5 lesson 10 (Home practical guide and safety card: scratch and bend tests (portal worksheet; no knives, adult present))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Compare how hard and how flexible materials are.
equipment: A coin, a bar of soap, wooden and metal spoons, a plastic lid
Strips of paper and card, a plastic ruler, a lolly stick
safety: Bend gently: stop before anything snaps
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Scratch each material gently with the coin. Does it leave a mark?
Bend each strip gently the same amount.
Rank the strips from most to least flexible.
